title: The Missing Streak
description: longest_streak(days) takes a list of True/False values (did you practice that day?) and returns the length of the longest run of True values.
hint: `best` is only updated when a streak is broken. What if the streak is still going when the list ends?
explanation: The best streak is only recorded when a False ends it. A streak that runs to the end of the list is never compared. Either update `best` on every True, or do one last `max(best, current)` after the loop.
